title: Final Fantasy IX
art_style: Hand-painted watercolor fantasy with warm golden tones, lush environments, and chibi-proportioned characters inspired by classic JRPG art. Soft lighting, rich colors, storybook aesthetic.
description: A sweeping tale of identity, belonging, and the bonds that give life meaning. Follow Zidane and friends from the kingdom of Alexandria across two worlds as they confront a cosmic threat born from one man's fear of mortality.
